text_en: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “Thus says the Lord : Set your house in order, for you shall die; you shall not recover. ”
text_cn: 在那些日期内，希则克雅害病要死，阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚先知前来看他，并对他说：“上主这样说：快料理你的家务，因为你快死，不能久活了！”

text_en: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord :
text_cn: 希则克雅就转面朝墙恳求上主说：

text_en: “Remember now, O Lord , I implore you, how I have walked before you in faithfulness with a whole heart, and have done what is good in your sight. ” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
text_cn: “上主！求你记忆我如何怀着忠诚齐全的心，在你面前行走；如何作了你视为正义的事。”然后希则克雅放声大哭。

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah:
text_cn: 上主的话传给依撒意亚说：

text_en: “Go and say to Hezekiah, Thus says the Lord , the God of your ancestor David: I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; I will add fifteen years to your life.
text_cn: “你去对希则克雅说：上主，你祖先达味的天主这样说：我听见了你的祈祷，看见了你的眼泪；看，我要在你的寿数上多加十五年，

text_en: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and defend this city.
text_cn: 且由亚述王手中拯救你和这座城，我必要保护这座城。

text_en: “This is the sign to you from the Lord , that the Lord will do this thing that he has promised:
text_cn: 上主必实践他所说的话，这将是给你的记号：

text_en: See, I will make the shadow cast by the declining sun on the dial of Ahaz turn back ten steps. ” So the sun turned back on the dial the ten steps by which it had declined.
text_cn: 看，我要使那射在阿哈次的日晷（guǐ）上的日影倒退十度。”果然，射在日晷上的日影倒退了十度。

text_en: A writing of King Hezekiah of Judah, after he had been sick and had recovered from his sickness:
text_cn: 犹大王希则克雅在病中与病愈后所咏的“金诗”：

text_en: I said: In the noontide of my days I must depart; I am consigned to the gates of Sheol for the rest of my years.
text_cn: 我曾想过：“正当我的中年，我就要离去；我的余年将被交于阴府之门。”

text_en: I said, I shall not see the Lord in the land of the living; I shall look upon mortals no more among the inhabitants of the world.
text_cn: 我曾想过：“我再不能在活人的地上看见上主， 我再不能在世上的居民中看见世人。

text_en: My dwelling is plucked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent; like a weaver I have rolled up my life; he cuts me off from the loom; from day to night you bring me to an end;
text_cn: 我的居所被拆除，由我身上撤去，仿佛牧童的帐幕；你好像织工，卷起了我的生命，由织机上将我割断。白日黑夜你总想将我结束！”

text_en: I cry for help until morning; like a lion he breaks all my bones; from day to night you bring me to an end.
text_cn: 我哀号直到清晨，上主却如狮子咬碎了我所有的骨骸。

text_en: Like a swallow or a crane I clamor, I moan like a dove. My eyes are weary with looking upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security!
text_cn: 我呢喃好似燕子，我哀鸣有如斑鸠；我痛哭的眼睛向上仰视：“上主！我实在痛苦，求你扶持我！”

text_en: But what can I say? For he has spoken to me, and he himself has done it. All my sleep has fled because of the bitterness of my soul.
text_cn: 我还有什么话可说？因为是上主给我说的，因为是他行的；带着我内心的痛苦，我要善度我的余年。

text_en: O Lord, by these things people live, and in all these is the life of my spirit. Oh, restore me to health and make me live!
text_cn: 吾主！我的心唯有仰望你！求你使我的精神苏醒，使我复原，使我生存。

text_en: Surely it was for my welfare that I had great bitterness; but you have held back my life from the pit of destruction, for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
text_cn: 看，我的苦楚已变为安宁，是你保存了我的生命脱免灭亡的深渊，因为你将我所有的罪恶尽抛于你背后。

text_en: For Sheol cannot thank you, death cannot praise you; those who go down to the Pit cannot hope for your faithfulness.
text_cn: 诚然，阴府不会赞颂你，死亡也不会称扬你：下到深渊的，也不会再仰望你的忠诚。

text_en: The living, the living, they thank you, as I do this day; fathers make known to children your faithfulness.
text_cn: 生者，唯有生者能赞颂你，如我今日一样；为父的当使自己的儿女认识你的忠信。

text_en: The Lord will save me, and we will sing to stringed instruments all the days of our lives, at the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 上主救了我，为此我们愿以终生的岁月，在上主的殿内弹奏弦琴！

text_en: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a lump of figs, and apply it to the boil, so that he may recover. ”
text_cn: 依撒意亚曾吩咐说：“拿一块无花果饼来，贴在他的疮口上，他就会好了。”

text_en: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord ? ”
text_cn: 希则克雅曾问说：“有什么凭据，我将登上上主的殿？”
